verdict: accept final82cd for bounded retained-JS cache savings, immutable shared host snapshot ownership and sustained-edit correctness; do not claim near-zero total RAM, uniformly lower host/browser memory or causal speedup

qualityBar.reference: Actual accepted Relay UI9af9442526cd82d6ce56dd6486da6ec32634c3a4, frozen e089dc02 release binary
requirements: Preserve actual native editing, selection, scroll clamp, history, disk conflict, dirty recovery, paired conversation and PTY semantics
Demonstrate reproducible material retained-memory reduction or deterministic copy reduction with actual-host measurements
Reject material repeated native end-to-end wall regressions even when handler or JS heap improves
Separate natural JS heap, retained JS heap, host RSS, macOS task footprint and isolated Chrome process RSS; retain unfavorable evidence
qualityBar.independence: Builder and critic are separate agents; performance scripts verify frozen binaries/assets. Variants are identified by SHA in evidence. This is an independent measured comparison, not a claimed label-blind human taste test.

acceptedPieces.evidence: Arc wrapper moves incoming text and shares source across history/view/rollback clones; root reports pointer-sharing, wire/recovery and rollback tests. Actual repeated ordinary/metadata/recovery footprint savings support a scoped benefit.
acceptedPieces.scope: No transport/checkpoint reduction. Copy elimination is deterministic; task footprint and RSS vary by phase and allocator/system state. Host RSS and tiny-line settled footprint increased in final repeat.

acceptedPieces.piece: Serialize concurrent document flushers until no newer inflight sender exists
acceptedPieces.evidence: Actual frozen baseline sustained native typing fails with conflict/readOnly in3of4 baseline probes across broad+focused suites. Final82cd passes all3 current broad+focused sustained probes; root delayed-ack proof establishes duplicate-send repair.
acceptedPieces.scope: Baseline broad trial2 happens to pass; race remains timing dependent. Timed comparison includes same separate sustained stress and explicit conflict recovery when baseline fails.

acceptedPieces.piece: Keep baseline full split/encoding/render behavior, own one active line cache, clear immediately on lifecycle transitions
acceptedPieces.evidence: Both exact50a broad trials retain desktop14.428MiB and phone14.410MiB afterGC at8docs versus baseline16.542/16.524MiB; focused retained result agrees. Independent cache lifecycle diagnostic proves inactive doc cache fields absent, switch/close/project/hidden release and reveal rebuild.
acceptedPieces.scope: ~12.8% less retained JS at8docs; after switching to a single longline the removed previous tiny-line cache gives a larger phase-specific36.6–37.2% reduction. One recovered document and closed retainedJS remain effectively unchanged. No sparse index, UTF8 fast path, viewportHTML cache or remote-native coalescing shipped.

rejectedPieces.piece: Sparse index, cached viewport HTML and reduced active UTF8 allocations
rejectedPieces.reason: Original matched ABBA repeats retain less JS but native paired typing and full edit wall regress materially. Baseline tiny16key trials range7.168–23.119sec; candidate25.345–51.427sec. Handler/scroll medians alone cannot establish overall performance.

Actual long→short→long source sequence while phone frame is held preserves stale backward350..950selection and800/150scroll instead of native baseline3..3 and0/0 clamp. Controlled20→1 setter batching does not prove a natural steady-typing win.

measurementSchedule.orderingLimit: Final82cd broad trials run later than original baseline ABBA. Reverse focused baseline shows large warm/system/GC ordering drift; do not infer a causal speedup or formal confidence interval from this single shared machine.

hostTaskFootprintPeakMiB.judgment: No universal peak reduction: first candidate63.9, repeat77.2 overlaps baseline77.1–80.5.

hostRssObservedPeakMiB.judgment: Candidate measured RSS peaks are higher. Do not advertise RSS reduction or treat compressed baseline RSS as its full host cost.

summary.endToEndLatency: Final current broad ordinary/tiny/singleline and20replacement walls show no repeated first-candidate regression. Focused third paired209k-line16key walls24.286/23.004sec compare reverse baseline23.315/23.293sec; ordinary3.145/3.062sec compare3.177/3.144sec. Phone-hidden third8.772/7.476sec lies between baseline first9.966/8.817 and reverse7.216/6.974; single4.624sec similarly between baseline4.969 and4.022. Treat these as parity with system/order noise, not speed wins.
summary.tailLatency: First third tiny-line handler p9544.9ms occurs once; finalrepeat9.8/10.6/8.7ms. Keep outlier visible; no universally improved tail claim.
summary.remainingNativeFloor: Focused phone native textarea retains roughly420k DOMnodes for209k lines afterGC, versus~1k when closed; preGC counts can hold2–4 detached subtrees. Phone Task~20sec and Layout~8.6sec per16keys dominate; hiding phone pane reduces Layout to near0 while still16 native setters. Browser rendererRSS ranges from about2–8GiB under this valid-file stress across baseline and candidates. Natural JS spikes(~84MiB desktop after20full replacements) differ sharply from14.5MiB retainedJS. NativeGC/OS allocation ordering prevents reliable totalRAM or browserRSS reduction attribution.

proofArtifacts.method: Actual disposable host and native textarea; delayed next frames only in correctness cases; exact frozen embedded assets; source remains in normal app model only
Frozen embedded source verified, then scalar-only cache lifecycle getter injected; controlled document.hidden and next-frame delay; correctness only, no performance claim
Actual disposable host and native textarea; delayed next frames only in correctness cases; exact frozen embedded assets; source remains in normal app model only

method.hostFootprint: macOS vmmap -summary per phase; OS physicalfootprint task accounting, including compressed memory charges; separately from RSS, not exact total system RAM
method.hostRss: macOS asynchronous ps RSS approximately every250ms with at most one in-flight probe; phase final median of final10samples after1.2sec settle; sampled peaks can miss shorter spikes
method.browserRss: isolated Chrome SystemInfo process IDs, ps RSS seven samples at80ms; browser, renderer and other categories separate; RSS includes shared pages, does not establish exact physical RAM
method.heap: Memory.getDOMCounters also records renderer DOM including native textarea internals without full snapshot; Runtime.getHeapUsage before GC (natural point sample) and after explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage (retained JS heap); excludes native browser/GPU/process costs; prior phase GC affects following phase
method.instrumentation: scalar counters only; no full source or protocol messages retained; source split/encoder/storage/DOM wrappers are equal overhead in A/B
method.timing: Trusted native keys, wait desktop shared metadata and passive phone native setter plus two frames per key; per-key driver/readiness/shared-state/render timings and both renderer CDP deltas; normal frame scheduling during all performance phases; single-machine timings noisy
method.providers: both CLIs shadowed with disposable fixtures; no real credentials or inference

exactRootValidation.source: Root supplied exact-binary validation, separate from independent benchmark

methodLimitations: Both provider CLIs are shadowed; no real inference, credentials, user project, tunnel or live8765/8767 used. Generatedstate/workspace and disposable/bin/sh only; inheritedENV/BASH_ENV absent in this environment.

Original50a hostRSS uses synchronousps approximately100ms and can stall benchmark driver. Current08ba uses asyncps250ms atmost1inflight. Only compare timing numbers within each harness; the original50a gate is preserved exactly.

Original50a timing description says host acknowledgment, but actual barrier is desktop scalar shared-state observation after each key, not a correlated command acknowledgment or phone-render barrier. Focused08ba separately waits desktop+phone shared-state and native setter revision plus2frames.

App-handler duration is capture-to-bubble input dispatch; excludes native preprocessing/layout beforeinput. Scroll timing is two-frame observation, not input-to-photon. CDP task/script/layout deltas provide attribution without claiming user-visible latency.

Heap natural point samples precede explicit phaseGC. Retained JS excludes native/GPU/browser/processmemory. Forced phaseGC affects following workload and does not represent natural longsession steady state.

macOS vmmap task physicalfootprint accounts compressed charges and is separate from RSS, not exact total physicalRAM. Chrome categoryRSS is shared-inclusive; never sum it with JS heap or hostfootprint to manufacture a total.

This shared Mac has substantialswap/compression drift; raw perphase memory_pressure/vm_stat/vm.swapusage are retained. Root stopped build/testbrowserwork during quietmeasurements, but unrelated system load was not controlled.

Sourcehooks in active-cache lifecycle proof are scalaronly correctness diagnostics against a verified frozenasset; they are not accepted performance numbers. Controlled heldframes/dispatchedcomposition do not prove OSIME behavior.
Native many-line textarea floor remains unresolved. Do not claim close-to-zero wholeappRAM, cured near-limit files, native-editor parity with other products, uniformly bettertails or causal speedups.
Repeated six-cycle hostRSS curves are nonmonotonic; closed/postrecovery processcharges persist. No monotonic leak demonstrated, and no allocation attribution or longsession leakproof claimed.
nextLargestPieces: Bound native input/viewport representation while preserving fullrange selection, OSIME, clipboard, accessibility and history; validate actual phones and longsessions.
Reduce full-source wire/events and durable checkpoint serialization with an explicitly fenced incremental protocol while preserving reconnect/recovery correctness.
Measure allocator/nativeDOM highwater under an isolated comparable naturalGC workload before any next overallmemory claim.
